text:
Bitcoin remains tightly coiled at $62,491 the afternoon of June 24, defending structural support amid deeply bearish "Extreme Fear" sentiment. Institutional headwinds persist, with U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs bleeding another $114 million in a fourth consecutive day of drawdowns. However, sell-side exhaustion is evident as the market anticipates tomorrow's massive BitMine Russell 1000 inclusion, which analysts project will force $2.15 billion in passive institutional buying.

European regulatory clarity continues to sharply contrast with U.S. legislative stagnation. As prediction market odds for the U.S. CLARITY Act plummet to 48%, firms like OpenPayd and NAGA Group successfully secured critical MiCA-compliant licenses ahead of the EU's July 1 deadline.

This cautious crypto consolidation is mirroring a broader macro stabilization. With the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield retreating to 4.41% and tech equities finding a floor, digital asset liquidity remains sidelined pending Thursday's highly anticipated PCE inflation print.
